question: Apple M1 Max single core IPC performance metrics

sources.title: Apple M1 - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: [6] The M1 Max is a higher-powered version of the M1 Pro with a larger die size. It doubled the GPU cores and memory bandwidth to 32 cores and 400GB/s respectively, keeping the same 10 core CPU. Apple later introduced the M1 Ultra in 2022, a desktop workstation chip containing two M1 Max units physically interconnected via 'UltraFusion'.
